name: @openagt/servers
description: Connect your VPS: give a server's address and a user name, and OpenAgent installs itself there over SSH, with this computer's own SSH keys. The server then starts OpenAgent by itself, opens its door over HTTPS, and is a machine a run can be sent to. The server gets its two logins from this computer, over SSH: your GitHub login, copied when you tick it, and a Claude login made for it with claude setup-token. It brings the Servers section of the dashboard's Settings page.

scripts.prepack: node -e "if(!process.env.npm_config_user_agent?.startsWith('pnpm/')){console.error('Pack and publish with pnpm: it replaces workspace:* with the real version, npm does not');process.exit(1)}"
scripts.test: tsc -p tsconfig.test.json && node --test --test-timeout=60000 'dist-test/**/*.test.js' && cd dashboard && vitest run
